membershipDescription: Members of the BPMA receive a complimentary membership to Direct Route (valued at £200.00 + Vat) plus zero cost debt recovery on all debts up to £3,000 with a subsidised cost of just 2% commission, payable only upon a successful recovery being effected. Additionally BPMA Members receive 600 complimentary units to AccountAssyst entitling them to up to 100 free credit reports or use of account opening services and automated online credit control chasing instead.
mailText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

Re: Invitation to activate your BPMA Zero Cost Debt Collection Service - [[ApplicantCompany]]  

We write further to our recent conversation concerning our debt collection services. 

As a BPMA Member we confirm that you are entitled to a complimentary registration with Direct Route (usual value £200.00 + Vat).   

We note that you require assistance with several overdue customers annually. Additionally you have advised that when outsourcing debt you ordinarily would not have any intention of future dealings with the customer.

Having considered the position therefore we are pleased to advise that you qualify for our BPMA Fairway Gold Membership service, this being the most appropriate for your needs. 

As a Fairway Gold client of Direct Route you will receive zero cost debt recovery on all debts up to £3000.00 and subsidised 2% recovery commission on all collected debts of greater value. 

If you have received this email then great news...you have already been pre-qualified for Fairway Gold Membership. This communication is simply your formal invitation to join. 

To accept your invitation simply follow this link [[MembershipFormLink]] to complete your Fairway Gold Membership Application Form.  
 
What Happens Next?

Once we receive your Membership Application Form [[MembershipFormLink]] we will process your application and activate your Fairway Gold Membership. We will also send you details of how to begin benefiting from the effective collection of all of your future overdue customers, starting immediately.        

All debt instructions submitted are subject to our [[TermsConditions]].

We very much look forward to hearing from you further. We are heer to help and support you in all things that are Credit Management related.
acceptanceText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

We are pleased to advise that your complimentary Fairway Gold Membership has now been approved (usual value £200.00 + Vat). This joining benefit is provided to you at no cost courtesy of your BPMA Membership.  

You may begin instructing us to collect debts with immediate effect.

Please send copy invoices or statements for all customers you would like chasing to newdebts@directroute.co.uk.

TOP TIP - Experience shows us that collection performance times are markedly improved if you are able to provide us with contact name(s), telephone numbers and email addresses for the customers you would like us to chase.

As a Direct Route Fairway Gold Member you receive zero cost debt collection on debts up to £3,000. For greater value debts you pay just a 2% + Vat commission, which is chargeable to you only upon successful recovery (no collection no commission charge). In summary your debt recovery cost is paid for in full by the customer if less than £3,000 or if your debt is for more than that the collection cost is subsidised by late payment fees recovered from your customer in addition to your overdue account.

Kindly note that all debt instructions received are subject to our [[TermsConditions]]. 

We very much look forward to receiving your first instructions and also to successfully recovering monies on your behalf for many years to come.

    ---------

PS - you may wish to note that you are entitled to a complimentary debt prevention solution, courtesy of the BPMA, that is provided by our sister company AccountAssyst. This entitles you to 600 units annually and enables you to access several essential support tools. Availaible for your use are free credit reports, opening of new customer accounts and professional credit control chasing. If you have not done so already simply visit https://www.accountassyst.co.uk to activate your initial free no obligation trial (your BPMA funded Benefit of a further 550 units is added after you have carried out this initial step and received your complimentary credit management consultancy).
